scientific_integrity: The global iff theorem follows from an all-degree Chebyshev-coefficient positivity proof; finite exact rational checks corroborate only bounded cases. Generic renewal and local restart criteria are prior work.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to nearest-neighbor finite paths, a forced-inward far endpoint, geometric one-step restart to the initial state, and mean target hitting times. No optimal reset value or uniqueness of its minimizer is established.
title: A sharp global reset-benefit boundary for reflected lattice searches
